name: street
description: Your day as one pixel tram street: each thing stands at its hour and the tram's nose is now. What waits on you stands on the pavement and boards the tram once it is settled; your threads are houses, your runs lamp posts, your schedules tram stops you pause or resume with a tap, and the crew walks ahead of the tram. Drag the street to see what stood at an hour; the hill holds your apps; switch a part off or reorder the hill and it stays that way. Its pixel faces, Pixelify Sans and Silkscreen, ship under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

tincture.tagline: Your day as a tram street, now at the tram
